policy.generator: syzkaller ifuzz table + opt-in ARMv8.1 LSE and forward-branch forms
policy.registers: Rn draws from x18-x25 which no instruction writes; other register fields randomized (6 clones per encoding); every variant must still decode to the same class
policy.correspondence: identical instruction encoding classes (ifuzz ParseInsn); every word validated as allocated and re-classified as labelled
policy.selection: class coverage 1.0, minimum Jensen-Shannon divergence, then end-state PC landing on the trailer BRK
policy.fix: --centered-data --data-pages 16 --ref-cores 0,32,64,96 --repeat 3; candidates ending before their trailer are discarded
